info.name: Un ragazzo veramente speciale
info.plot: Quando Ashtray (Shawn Wayans) si trasferisce a South Central LA per vivere con suo padre (che sembra avere la stessa età che ha lui) e nonna (a cui piace parlare duro e fumare birra), si imbatte in sua cugina gangbang Loc Dog (Marlon Wayans), che insieme alle pistole richieste e Uzi porta una testata termo-nucleare per autodifesa. Ashtray sarà in grado di continuare a vivere una vita etero?
info.original_name: Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood

translations.tagline: Le sua vera passione erano... le bibite

translations.overview: When Ashtray moves to South Central L.A. to live with his father (who appears to be the same age he is) and grandmother (who likes to talk tough and smoke reefer), he falls in with his gang-banging cousin Loc Dog, who along with the requisite pistols and Uzi carries a thermo-nuclear warhead for self-defense. Will Ashtray be able to keep living the straight life?
translations.tagline: Finally, the movie that proves that Justice isn't always Poetic, Jungle Fever isn't always pretty, and Higher Learning can be a waste of time.
